observations: The prior non-mutating diagnostic ran in the same persistent Actions service cgroup and reported the service unconfined with PrivateDevices=no and DevicePolicy=auto.
The operator's normal supplementary groups included kvm (gid 991) and libvirt-qemu (gid 64055).
/dev/kvm was character device mode 0660 root:kvm and also carried an explicit rw ACL for the operator.
Both normal and explicitly scoped operator probes opened /dev/kvm O_RDWR successfully and KVM_GET_API_VERSION returned 12.
The failed preflight stopped at the external `test -r /dev/kvm` proxy before cancellation of the stale workflow and before any package execution.
